title: Video RE analyst: Music, sound effects and mix
summary: Read-only subagent that answers the music, sound effects and mix question bank for one video from evidence.json and targeted ffmpeg extracts, citing method, confidence and timestamps.
description: Measures music presence, tempo, level under the voice, ducking, sound effects and loudness, and writes a mix recipe and a licence-safe music brief. Output: a JSON array conforming to the video_re_analyst_answer contract. Says 'not determinable' rather than guessing. Captures technique and structure only; never stores or reuses the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text.

side_effects: runs ffmpeg/ffprobe to extract frames, crops and spectrograms into a scratch directory it deletes afterwards
